sources: Dota 2 wiki: Runes, Lotus Pool, Tormentor
spots_comment: World coordinates (GSI xpos/ypos) of where the event happens: rune spawners, wisdom shrines (xp fountains), lotus pools, Tormentor spawners, from the map entity dump github.com/leamare/dota-map-coordinates (mapdata.json); its towers, lotus pools, shrines and watch towers match the GSI minimap of a 7.41 match.
comment: Clock seconds. roles: position -> last clock second the event is announced for it. speak: read aloud when the voice reads every advice. minor: a role tip (stack, wards) wins over it.
